disenos_foto.brief: AVOID generic template design: no laurel leaves or botanical sprigs, no rows of circular icons, no pill-shaped buttons, no centered symmetrical flyer layout, no ribbons, no script/handwritten fonts, no clip-art ornaments, no stock 'luxury' clichés. Make bold, original art direction worthy of an award-winning design studio. Palette: burgundy #811721, deep wine #5E0F17, cream #FCF1E1, beige #F3D8B9, muted gold #9C6A2B. Titles in a tall, narrow art-deco display typeface like the logo; small text in a clean modern sans. Spanish text spelled exactly as given and nothing else written. No prices, no people, nothing sexual or suggestive. Keep key content away from the top 220 px and bottom 300 px. Vertical 9:16 Instagram Story for Hotel Le Chateau. Art direction: a 1920s Art Deco travel poster in the spirit of Cassandre: strong geometric composition, flat color planes, stepped frames and radiating lines, dramatic perspective. The photo area is a tall arched window cut into the poster. Text: 'TU PRÓXIMA PAUSA' (big), 'PROVIDENCIA · SANTIAGO' (small), 'RESERVA POR WHATSAPP' (small, discreet).
